To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the scientific production of full-time faculty of National School of Public is essentially characterized by conformity with priority research lines, unevenly distribution of publication among the members of faculty, multiple authorship and thematic dispersion.

the scientific production of full-time faculty of NSPH in the Scopus Database was mainly characterized by the conformity of the research lines, the unequal distribution of the publications among the members, the multiple author and thematic dispersion.

the National School of Health Sciences has a scientific production in Scopus database that is characterized by the predominance of the role of secondary and tertiary authors, the uneven distribution of the publications among its faculty members, the thematic dispersion and the predominance of Cuban journals.

the scientific production of our faculty in Scopus database.
the need to improve the scientific productivity and to strengthen the quality of the research.
the characterization of the scientific production in the National School of Health Public in the Scopus data base, 2006 to 2012.
